Maria Chen: Quick async check-in for SDKs / quickstarts / sample app fixes.

Maria Chen: What I did — landed Python SDK fix for streaming error handling, updated sampleapp README with new env var examples. Pushed doc changes to branch `docs/quickstart-fix`.
Maria Chen: Blockers — CI macOS wheel is flaky (failing binary wheel upload). Need someone to help repro on arm64.
Maria Chen: Today — coordinate with infra for macOS runner, cut docs patch, ship quickstart v2.

Raj Patel: Saw the macOS failure, can repro on my M1. Probably a libc tagging issue. Will try a rebuild with `--plat-name` and post results.

Kevin O'Connor: Pushed a small Dockerfile tweak to reduce sampleapp image layers. Nightly build queued.

Tia Gomez: Noted a docs mismatch: quickstart examples still reference `API_KEY` env var; runtime expects `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. I flagged in the PR.

docs-bot: New docs preview available — https://docs-preview.internal/redwood/patch-312 (expires in 48h)

Maria Chen: @Raj can you add the mac wheel repro steps to the dev guide? Example command I used: 
```bash
python -m pip wheel --no-binary :all: .
```
This helped reproduce locally.

Raj Patel: Yep will add steps + tempfile-based repro script to the PR. Also looping in @eng-infra for mac runner logs.

Kevin O'Connor: @Maria left a tiny naming comment on the streaming handler in your PR. If you want I can pair-review.

Maria Chen: Thanks Kevin — will address and squash.

Tia Gomez: I'll update quickstart slides for the customer webinar and sync with docs preview. Draft by EOD.

Maria Chen: Blocker update — infra scheduled macOS runner maintenance at 17:00 UTC which should clear flaky agents. If green I'll merge by EOD :thumbsup: 

Kevin O'Connor: :rocket:

docs-bot: Build status — sampleapp image built successfully (sha256:abc123...), docs lint passed.

Maria Chen: Thanks everyone. Marking as done for today; will follow up tomorrow morning with merge status.
